description: This file contains the implementation of the Composer ClassLoader class, which implements PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap autoloading mechanisms for PHP applications. It includes methods for registering, unregistering, and finding class files based on various autoloading standards.

classes.name: ClassLoader
classes.description: Implements a versatile autoloading mechanism supporting PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap loading standards, allowing registration, unregistration, and file resolution for class files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ClassLoader instance with an optional vendor directory and sets up the include closure.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the autoloader with SPL autoload stack, with optional prepend.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters this autoloader from SPL autoload stack.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Attempts to load the class by finding its file and including it.

methods.name: findFile
methods.description: Locates the file path for a given class name, based on class map, PSR-0, PSR-4, or include path.

methods.name: findFileWithExtension
methods.description: Finds the class file with a specific extension, respecting PSR-4, PSR-0 rules, and fallback directories.
